outline:
選修介紹材料通性、分類與應用，並深入高分子生成之聚合反應、反應機構、反應動力學、熱力學、聚合物之材料構造、聚合方法、分子量之測定、分子量分佈以及一般檢測高分子特性之技術。
This course is concerned primarily with the synthesis, properties, and technology of synthetic polymers. Topics include polymerization, structure and properties, characterization , and properties of commercial polymers
schedule:

3. Molecular Weight and Molecular Weight Distribution
4. Stepwise Polymerization
5. Stepwise Polymerization

7. Free Radical Chain Polymerization

12. Ziegler-Natta Polymerization and Metathesis Polymerization
13. Ring-Opening Polymerization
14. Living Free-Radical Polymerization
15. Nature Polymers
16. Reaction of Polymers
17. Structure and Polymer Properties
18. Final
